summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Avenir Minerals Limited, acquired 666,667 units of Canada Nickel Company Inc. in a non-brokered private placement. Each unit consisted of one common share and one-half of a warrant, priced at C$1.50 per unit, totaling C$1,000,000.50. Warrants allow purchase of one common share at C$2.25 for 36 months. Following the placement, Avenir's ownership stands at approximately 8.68% (non-diluted) and 11.52% (partially diluted). This is an incremental investment, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisors were mentioned. This filing is routine investment disclosure.
